scene.title: The Strixwolf Mother
scene.short: A strange winged wolf-owl mother guards her pups while feeding from the dead driver.
scene.long: The obvious monster is not necessarily the killer. She is frightening, hungry, and protective. This is a moral scene disguised as a monster scene.

combatants.name: Strixwolf Mother
combatants.summary: A huge owl-wolf mother crouched around her pups, barred feathers and fur bristling, acting from protection rather than malice.
combatants.wants: Keep the pups fed and far from armed strangers.
combatants.fears: A sudden rush toward the pups, fire, and cornered noise.
sample_dialogue: She does not speak; she lowers her wings over the pups and tracks hands, not faces.

combatants.name: Strixwolf Pup One
combatants.summary: A wet-feathered strixwolf pup with oversized ears, bright frightened eyes, and paws too large for the body it has not grown into yet.
combatants.wants: To get back under its mother's wing without anyone deciding it is a trophy or a threat.
combatants.fears: Loud voices, hands that reach too fast, and the open ground between itself and its mother.
sample_dialogue: A thin rising click, like a question no one answers.
A whimper that cuts off the instant a hand moves too quickly.

combatants.name: Strixwolf Pup Two
combatants.summary: A crouched strixwolf pup with darker back feathers, round eyes, and a body tucked near the roots as if the forest itself might hide it.
combatants.wants: To stay hidden until the danger walks past, and never to be separated from the only family it has.
combatants.fears: Being flushed out of cover, losing sight of its sibling, the cold gap where its mother should be.
sample_dialogue: A low wet trill, almost swallowed by the roots.
Silence, then the smallest scrabble of claws deeper into the dark.

combatants.name: Tamsin Vell
combatants.summary: The dead driver at the overturned cart; evidence suggests humanoid murder, not just animal attack.
combatants.wants: In life, finish one more delivery and get home with enough coin to reduce her debt.
combatants.fears: Dying as paperwork: an unpaid balance, an undelivered crate, and no person left in the story.
sample_dialogue: Her voice is unavailable; use letters, route notes, and small belongings instead.

combatants.name: Sablewood Hybrid Fauna
combatants.summary: Sablewood fauna mix familiar animal shapes into unfamiliar pressures: Cat-Squirrels, Giraffe-Deer, Lemur-Toads, Fox-Bats, Horse-Goats, Bullfrogs, Strixwolves, Eeligators, and stranger deep-wood hybrids.
combatants.wants: Reach safety on its own terms and communicate danger through behavior before the party turns the moment into combat.
combatants.fears: Being surrounded, misread as a monster, or driven toward Sablewood™ Logistics Preserve, Cat-Squirrels, Giraffe-Deer by noise and haste.

combatants.name: Khari Nix

combat.title: Open Vale Ritual Defense
combat.aggression: Relentless but procedural; threats follow old infrastructure logic.
combat.startingPosition: The Custodian and Keystone hold the center; PCs form a protective ring while skeletons rise Close and wraiths pressure from Far.
combat.enemyEntry: Skeletons rise from Close ground; Wraiths drift from Far edges toward the ritual center.
combat.socialDefeat: Wraiths can be blunted by freely given care, unpriced memory, or communal protection, but not bargained with like people.
combat.violentConsequence: Destroying threats buys time but does not fix the ward economy; a fractured ward makes the Relay Spire hook urgent.
combat.mercyReward: Protecting the Custodian well restores a stronger ward and earns warmer truth.
combatantNotes: Skeletons hold lines and obey old security logic.
Wraiths pressure value, memory, and fear.
snappyLines: The wraith does not shout. It asks what your safety is worth.
The skeleton's jaw clicks like an old lock finding its key.

combatants.name: Whitefire Custodian
combatants.summary: Old faerie-like custodian who maintains the ward protecting Hush.
combatants.wants: Renew the ward without being treated as a device.
combatants.fears: The stone waking hungry, the Relay failing, and being remembered as infrastructure instead of a person.
sample_dialogue: Please do not call me the ward interface.
A contract can move a package. It cannot decide what a life is worth.
If you are here to help, stand where help costs you something.

combatants.name: Legacy Security Skeleton
combatants.summary: Obsolete security protocols made bone and rust.
combatants.stat_summary: Use module stat block. Group Attack requires Fear.
combatants.wants: Hold the post because the old order is the only command still left.
combatants.fears: No fear as a tactical creature; the person-layer feared leaving loved ones with the debt.
sample_dialogue: Permit... expired.
Post... must hold.
Debt remains. Door remains.

combatants.name: Soul-Audit Wraith
combatants.summary: A terrifying wraith that attacks memory, vulnerability, and soul tether.
combatants.stat_summary: Use module stat block. Lifedrain, Memory Delve, Pass-Through.
combatants.wants: Convert protection, memory, and fear into collectable balance.
combatants.fears: Freely given protection and memories that refuse a price.
sample_dialogue: Please state the value of what you refuse to lose.
Unfiled grief accrues.
Protection without invoice is an irregularity.

combatants.name: Eeligator
combatants.summary: A blackwater predator with an alligator's jaws, an eel's coiling body, green-blue eyes, and whiskered fins that read the river before prey knows it has been noticed.
combatants.stat_summary: Tier 1 Solo. Difficulty 14, thresholds 12/25, HP 7, Stress 5. Pull Under can make a target Restrained and Drowning.
combatants.wants: Win the immediate objective connected to The Lucent River, Eeligator Scale Shield, The High Falls, not simply kill the party.
combatants.fears: Failing the people or protocol behind them, being captured without being heard, or learning the fight served someone else's ledger.
sample_dialogue: Eeligator: We were told the road was theirs because they could afford the sign.
